title: Troubleshooting UI + redeploy documentation for Canister ID resolution issues

requirements.summary: Add a public troubleshooting page/panel for “Canister ID Not Resolved” with copyable icp0.io and raw.icp0.io URLs derived from the app canister ID.
acceptanceCriteria: A new UI section/page exists titled "Troubleshooting: Canister ID Not Resolved" (or similar) with clear English text.
The panel includes copyable URLs for both formats: https://<CANISTER_ID>.icp0.io and https://<CANISTER_ID>.raw.icp0.io (using the app canister ID available at build time).
The panel includes at least: refresh/wait guidance, try alternate network/browser guidance, and a note that this is typically routing/edge propagation.
The panel is reachable from an existing navigation area (e.g., footer or About page) without requiring authentication.

file_operations.description: Create a new public page titled “Troubleshooting: Canister ID Not Resolved” explaining the error in clear English and showing copyable icp0.io + raw.icp0.io access URLs derived from the build-time canister ID; use shadcn-ui components (e.g., Card/Button/Input) to present the panel and copy controls. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.
Add a small utility to read the app canister ID from available build-time environment variables and generate the two access URLs used by the troubleshooting page.
Register a new route for the troubleshooting page so it is navigable within the existing router configuration.
Add a footer navigation link to the troubleshooting route so it’s reachable without authentication from an existing navigation area.

requirements.summary: Add a developer-facing redeploy guide document with clean redeploy commands, canister ID verification, and quick troubleshooting checklist for “Canister ID Not Resolved”.
acceptanceCriteria: A new doc file exists in the repository (e.g., DEPLOYMENT.md) with step-by-step commands for a clean redeploy.
The doc includes verification steps to confirm the canister IDs being used and how to open the app via icp0.io and raw.icp0.io.
The doc includes a brief checklist of common causes for 'Canister ID Not Resolved' and what to try before redeploying.

file_operations.description: Create a developer-focused redeploy guide (stop/clean/redeploy/verify canister IDs) including steps to confirm the canister IDs in use and how to open via icp0.io and raw.icp0.io, plus a short checklist of common causes and what to try before redeploying.
